152        public static class SimUnlocksData {
153                public LinkedHashSet<String> factions = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
154                public LinkedHashSet<String> variants = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
155                
156                public void fromJSON(JSONObject json) {
157                        factions = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
158                        JSONArray arr = json.optJSONArray("factions");
159                        if (arr != null) {
160                                for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
161                                        String value = arr.optString(i);
162                                        if (value != null) {
163                                                factions.add(value);
164                                        }
165                                }
166                        }
167                        variants = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
168                        arr = json.optJSONArray("variants");
169                        if (arr != null) {
170                                for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
171                                        String value = arr.optString(i);
172                                        if (value != null) {
173                                                variants.add(value);
174                                        }
175                                }
176                        }
177                }
178                
179                public JSONObject toJSON() throws JSONException {
180                        JSONObject json = new JSONObject();
181
182                        JSONArray arr1 = new JSONArray();
183                        for (String value : factions) {
184                                arr1.put(value);
185                        }
186                        JSONArray arr2 = new JSONArray();
187                        for (String value : variants) {
188                                arr2.put(value);
189                        }
190                        
191                        json.put("factions", arr1);
192                        json.put("variants", arr2);
193
194                        return json;
195                }
196        }

211        public boolean coreReqsMet(String coreId) {
212                if (!REQUIRE_AI_CORES || !Global.getCombatEngine().isInCampaignSim()) return true;
213                if (isSimFullyUnlocked()) return true;
214                //return Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getQuantity(CargoItemType.RESOURCES, coreId) > 0;
215                return getAvailableAICores().getCount(coreId) > 0;
216        }
217        
218        public boolean isRequireAICoresInCargo() {
219                if (!REQUIRE_AI_CORES_IN_CARGO) return false;
220                if (isSimFullyUnlocked()) return false;
221                return Global.getCombatEngine().isInCampaignSim();
222        }

241        public void loadCustomOpponents() {
242                try {
243                        if (Global.getSettings().fileExistsInCommon(CUSTOM_OPPONENTS_FILE)) {
244                                customOpponents = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
245                                JSONObject json = Global.getSettings().readJSONFromCommon(CUSTOM_OPPONENTS_FILE, true);
246                                JSONArray arr = json.optJSONArray("opponents");
247                                if (arr != null) {
248                                        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
249                                                String variantId = arr.getString(i);
250                                                if (Global.getSettings().getVariant(variantId) == null) continue;
251                                                customOpponents.add(variantId);
252                                        }
253                                }
254                        } else {
255                                clearCustomOpponents();
256                        }
257                } catch (IOException e) {
258                        e.printStackTrace();
259                } catch (JSONException e) {
260                        e.printStackTrace();
261                }
262        }
263        
264        public void saveCustomOpponents() {
265                try {
266                        JSONObject json = new JSONObject();
267                        JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
268                        for (String variantId : customOpponents) {
269                                arr.put(variantId);
270                        }
271                        json.put("opponents", arr);
272                        Global.getSettings().writeJSONToCommon(CUSTOM_OPPONENTS_FILE, json, true);
273                } catch (JSONException e) {
274                        e.printStackTrace();
275                } catch (IOException e) {
276                        e.printStackTrace();
277                }
278        }

280        public void resetToDefaults(boolean withSave) {
281                uiStateData.settings.clear();
282                uiStateData.settings.put(AGGRO_ID, AGGRO_DEFAULT);
283                uiStateData.settings.put(AGGRO_ID_CORES_ONLY, AGGRO_DEFAULT);
284                uiStateData.settings.put(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_ID, OFFICERS_NONE);
285                uiStateData.settings.put(OFFICERS_ID, OFFICERS_NONE);
286                uiStateData.settings.put(QUALITY_ID, QUALITY_NO_DMODS);
287                uiStateData.settings.put(AI_CORES_ID, AI_CORES_NONE);
288                uiStateData.settings.put(AI_CORES_DERELICT_ID, AI_CORES_NONE);
289                uiStateData.settings.put(AI_CORES_OMEGA_ID, AI_CORES_NONE);
290                uiStateData.settings.put(RANDOMIZE_VARIANTS_ID, "false");
291                uiStateData.settings.put(INTEGRATE_CORES_ID, "false");
292                uiStateData.groupSize = 0;
293                if (withSave) {
294                        saveUIStateData();
295                }
296        }

365        public List<AdvancedSimOption> getSimOptions(SimCategoryData category) {
366                List<AdvancedSimOption> result = new ArrayList<AdvancedSimOption>();
367
368                boolean custom = CUSTOM_CAT_ID.equals(category.id);
369                boolean other = OTHER_CAT_ID.equals(category.id);
370                boolean defaultCat = DEFAULT_CAT_ID.equals(category.id);
371                boolean civ = CIV_CAT_ID.equals(category.id);
372                boolean dev = DEV_CAT_ID.equals(category.id);
373                boolean customFaction = custom || civ || dev || defaultCat || other;
374                
375                JSONObject json = category.faction.getCustom().optJSONObject("simulatorData");
376                boolean standardAICores = json != null && json.optBoolean("standardAICores");
377                boolean derelictAICores = json != null && json.optBoolean("derelictAICores");
378                boolean omegaAICores = json != null && json.optBoolean("omegaAICores");
379                boolean noOfficers = json != null && json.optBoolean("noOfficers");
380                
381                boolean showOfficers = !standardAICores && !derelictAICores && !omegaAICores && !noOfficers;
382                boolean integrateCores = standardAICores || derelictAICores || dev || custom || other;
383                
384                if (custom || defaultCat || other) {
385                        showOfficers = true;
386                        standardAICores = true;
387                        integrateCores = true;
388                }
389                
390                String aggroExtra = "";
391                String aiExtra = "";
392                if (custom || defaultCat || dev || other) {
393                        aggroExtra = "\n\nDoes not affect AI cores or automated ships.";
394                        aiExtra = "\n\nOnly affects automated ships.";
395                }
396                
397                String aggroTitle = "Aggression / behavior";
398                String aggroId = AGGRO_ID;
399                if (!showOfficers) {
400                        aggroTitle = "Behavior";
401                        aggroId = AGGRO_ID_CORES_ONLY;
402                }
403                
404                SimOptionSelectorData aggro = new SimOptionSelectorData(aggroId, aggroTitle, true);
405                if (showOfficers) {
406                        if (custom || defaultCat || civ || dev || other) {
407                                aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_DEFAULT, "Default (steady)", 
408                                                Global.getSettings().getPersonaltySpec(Personalities.STEADY).getDescription().replaceAll("officer", "aggression level") + aggroExtra, "behavior_default"));
409                        } else {
410                                aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_DEFAULT, "Faction default", 
411                                                "Default aggression level for the selected faction." + aggroExtra, "behavior_default"));
412                        }
413                        aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_CAUTIOUS, "Cautious",
414                                        Global.getSettings().getPersonaltySpec(Personalities.CAUTIOUS).getDescription().replaceAll("officer", "aggression level") + aggroExtra, "behavior_cautious"));
415                        aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_STEADY, "Steady",
416                                        Global.getSettings().getPersonaltySpec(Personalities.STEADY).getDescription().replaceAll("officer", "aggression level") + aggroExtra, "behavior_steady"));
417                        aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_AGGRESSIVE, "Aggressive", 
418                                        Global.getSettings().getPersonaltySpec(Personalities.AGGRESSIVE).getDescription().replaceAll("officer", "aggression level") + aggroExtra, "behavior_aggressive"));
419                        aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_RECKLESS, "Reckless", 
420                                        Global.getSettings().getPersonaltySpec(Personalities.RECKLESS).getDescription().replaceAll("officer", "aggression level") + aggroExtra, "behavior_reckelss"));
421                } else {
422                        aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_NORMAL, "Normal", "Opposing ships will behave normally.", "behavior_default"));
423                }
424                
425                aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_DO_NOTHING, "Do nothing", "Opposing ships will not move, use shields, fire weapons, or take any other actions.", "behavior_passive"));
426                if (showOfficers) {
427                        aggro.options.get(aggro.options.size() - 1).extraPad = 10f;
428                }
429                aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_DEFENSES, "Stationary, defenses only", "Opposing ships will not move, but will use shields/phase cloak/other defenses and defensive ship systems, if any.", "behavior_defensive"));
430                aggro.options.add(new SimOptionData(AGGRO_STATIONARY, "Stationary", "Opposing ships will not move, but will otherwise behave normally.", "behavior_stationary"));
431                aggro.compact = false;
432                result.add(aggro);
433                
434                
435                if (showOfficers) {
436                        if (customFaction) {
437                                SimOptionSelectorData officers = new SimOptionSelectorData(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_ID, "Officers", true);
438                                officers.options.add(new SimOptionData(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_NONE, "None", "No officers on any opposing ships.", "officers_none"));
439                                officers.options.add(new SimOptionData(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_SOME, "Some", "Some officers, up to level 5.", "officers_some"));
440                                officers.options.add(new SimOptionData(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_5, "All ships, level 5", "Level 5 officers on all opposing ships.", "officers_all"));
441                                officers.options.add(new SimOptionData(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_6, "All ships, level 6", "Level 6 officers on all opposing ships.", "officers_high"));
442                                result.add(officers);                   
443                        } else {
444                                SimOptionSelectorData officers = new SimOptionSelectorData(OFFICERS_ID, "Officers", true);
445                                officers.options.add(new SimOptionData(OFFICERS_NONE, "None", "No officers on any opposing ships.", "officers_none"));
446                                officers.options.add(new SimOptionData(OFFICERS_DEFAULT, "Faction default", "Default number and level of officers for the selected faction.", "officers_some"));
447                                officers.options.add(new SimOptionData(OFFICERS_ALL, "All ships", "Maximum level officers on all opposing ships.", "officers_high"));
448                                result.add(officers);
449                        }
450                }
451                
452                if (standardAICores || derelictAICores || omegaAICores || custom || defaultCat || dev || other) {
453                        String coresId = AI_CORES_ID;
454                        if (dev) {
455                                coresId = AI_CORES_DEV_ID;
456                        } else if (omegaAICores) {
457                                coresId = AI_CORES_OMEGA_ID;
458                        } else if (derelictAICores) {
459                                coresId = AI_CORES_DERELICT_ID;
460                        }
461                        SimOptionSelectorData cores = new SimOptionSelectorData(coresId, "AI cores", false);
462                        cores.options.add(new SimOptionData(AI_CORES_NONE, "None", "No AI cores on any opposing ships.", "cores_none"));
463
464                        boolean enableAlpha = coreReqsMet(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE);
465                        boolean enableBeta = coreReqsMet(Commodities.BETA_CORE) || enableAlpha;
466                        boolean enableGamma = coreReqsMet(Commodities.GAMMA_CORE) || enableBeta;
467                        boolean enableMixed = enableAlpha || (derelictAICores && enableGamma);
468
469                        String reqGamma = null;
470                        if (!enableGamma) reqGamma = "Requires a Gamma Core or better in your cargo.";
471                        String reqBeta = null;
472                        if (!enableBeta) reqBeta = "Requires a Beta Core or better in your cargo.";
473                        String reqAlpha = null;
474                        if (!enableAlpha) reqAlpha = "Requires an Alpha Core in your cargo.";
475                        String reqMixed = null;
476                        if (!enableMixed) {
477                                if (derelictAICores) {
478                                        reqMixed = "Requires a Gamma Core or better in your cargo.";
479                                } else {
480                                        reqMixed = "Requires an Alpha Core in your cargo.";
481                                }
482                        }
483                        
484                        String coresCargoNote = "";
485                        String ifPossible = "";
486                        if (isRequireAICoresInCargo()) {
487                                coresCargoNote = " The AI cores used are limited to the total number and type "
488                                                + "of cores in your cargo (and storage, if docked).";
489                                ifPossible = ", if possible";
490                                boolean canUseCores = enableGamma || enableBeta || enableAlpha || enableMixed;
491                                if (canUseCores) {
492                                        enableGamma = enableBeta = enableAlpha = enableMixed = true;
493                                        reqGamma = reqBeta = reqAlpha = reqMixed = null;
494                                } else {
495                                        enableGamma = enableBeta = enableAlpha = enableMixed = false;
496                                        reqGamma = reqBeta = reqAlpha = reqMixed = "No AI cores in cargo (or storage, if docked).";
497                                }
498                        }
499                        
500                        if (standardAICores || derelictAICores || dev) {
501                                cores.options.add(new SimOptionData(AI_CORES_SOME, "Mixed", "A mix of AI cores on some of the opposing ships, based on the number and size of opponents deployed." + coresCargoNote + aiExtra, enableMixed, reqMixed, "cores_mixed"));
502                                cores.options.add(new SimOptionData(AI_CORES_GAMMA, "Gamma cores on all ships", "A gamma core on every opposing ship" + ifPossible + "." + coresCargoNote + aiExtra, enableGamma, reqGamma, "cores_gamma"));
503                                if (standardAICores || dev) {
504                                        cores.options.add(new SimOptionData(AI_CORES_BETA, "Beta cores on all ships", "A beta core on every opposing ship" + ifPossible + "." + coresCargoNote + aiExtra, enableBeta, reqBeta, "cores_beta"));
505                                        cores.options.add(new SimOptionData(AI_CORES_ALPHA, "Alpha cores on all ships", "An alpha core on every opposing ship" + ifPossible + "." + coresCargoNote + aiExtra, enableAlpha, reqAlpha, "cores_alpha"));
506                                }
507                        }
508                        if (dev || omegaAICores) {
509                                cores.options.add(new SimOptionData(AI_CORES_OMEGA, "Omega cores on all ships", "An omega core on every opposing ship." + aiExtra, "cores_omega"));
510                        }
511                        if (!omegaAICores) {
512                                cores.padAfter = 10f;
513                        }
514                        result.add(cores);      
515                }
516                
517                if (integrateCores) {
518                        String iTooltipExtra = "";
519                        if (dev) {
520                                iTooltipExtra = "\n\nDoes not affect omega cores.";
521                        }
522                        SimOptionCheckboxData integrate = new SimOptionCheckboxData(INTEGRATE_CORES_ID, "Integrate AI cores",
523                                        "AI cores will be integrated into opposing ships, increasing each core's level by 1." + iTooltipExtra);
524                        // no longer relevant since aggression/behavior is no longer condensed and is taller
525//                      if (!custom && !dev && !defaultCat && !other) { 
526//                              integrate.padAfter += 8f;
527//                      }
528                        result.add(integrate);
529                }
530
531                
532                SimOptionSelectorData quality = new SimOptionSelectorData(QUALITY_ID, "Ship quality", true);
533                quality.options.add(new SimOptionData(QUALITY_MAX_DMODS, "Maximum d-mods", "Five d-mods on all opposing ships.", "quality_lowest"));
534                quality.options.add(new SimOptionData(QUALITY_SOME_DMODS, "Some d-mods", "Two to four d-mods on all opposing ships.", "quality_low"));
535                quality.options.add(new SimOptionData(QUALITY_NO_DMODS, "No d-mods", "No d-mods on any opposing ships.", "quality_no_dmods"));
536                quality.options.add(new SimOptionData(QUALITY_SOME_SDMODS, "Some s-mods", "One or two s-mods on all opposing ships.", "quality_high"));
537                quality.options.add(new SimOptionData(QUALITY_MANY_SMODS, "Many s-mods", "Two or three s-mods on all opposing ships.", "quality_highest"));
538                result.add(quality);
539                
540                // no longer relevant since aggression/behavior is no longer condensed and is taller
541//              if (!custom && !dev && !defaultCat && !other) {
542//                      quality.padAfter += 11f; // to line it up with the separator line between deployed/reserve
543//              }
544                
545                
546                String rTooltipExtra = "";
547                if (customFaction) {
548                        rTooltipExtra = "\n\nFor the selected category, uses a broader set of weapons than is available to most factions.";
549                }
550                SimOptionCheckboxData loadouts = new SimOptionCheckboxData(RANDOMIZE_VARIANTS_ID, "Randomized loadouts",
551                                "Opposing ships have randomized loadouts when this setting is enabled." + rTooltipExtra);
552                result.add(loadouts);
553                
554                return result;
555        }

585        public List<SimCategoryData> getCategories() {
586                if (!loadedStuff) {
587                        loadCustomOpponents();
588                        loadUnlocksData();
589                        loadedStuff = true;
590                }
591                
592                boolean fullUnlock = isSimFullyUnlocked() || isAllStandardStuffUnlocked();
593                
594                List<SimCategoryData> result = new ArrayList<SimulatorPlugin.SimCategoryData>();
595                
596                Set<String> civilian = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
597                
598                Set<String> other = new LinkedHashSet<String>(unlocksData.variants);
599//              if (other.contains("doom_Strike")) {
600//                      System.out.println("23dfefewf");
601//              }
602//              other.clear();
603                if (Global.getCombatEngine().isInCampaignSim() && INCLUDE_PLAYER_BLUEPRINTS) {
604                        FactionAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
605                        for (String roleId : getAllRoles()) {
606                                Set<String> variants = player.getVariantsForRole(roleId);
607                                if (variants == null) continue;
608                                other.addAll(variants);
609                        }
610                }
611                
612                
613                for (FactionSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllFactionSpecs()) {
614                        if (spec == null || spec.getCustom() == null) continue;
615                        
616                        JSONObject json = spec.getCustom().optJSONObject("simulatorData");
617                        if (json == null) continue;
618                        
619                        boolean show = json.optBoolean("showInSimulator");
620                        show |= isShowDevCategories() && json.optBoolean("showInSimulatorDevModeOnly");
621                        
622                        show &= fullUnlock || unlocksData.factions.contains(spec.getId());
623                        
624                        if (!show) continue;
625                        
626                        boolean includeCiv = json.optBoolean("includeCivShipsWithFaction");
627                        
628                        SimCategoryData data = new SimCategoryData();
629                        data.id = spec.getId();
630                        data.name = Misc.ucFirst(spec.getDisplayName());
631                        data.nameColor = spec.getBaseUIColor();
632                        data.iconName = spec.getCrest();
633                        data.data = spec;
634                        data.variants = getVariants(spec, includeCiv, false, false);
635                        data.maxVariants = getVariants(spec, includeCiv, false, true).size();
636                        data.faction = Global.getSettings().createBaseFaction(spec.getId());
637                        
638                        if (!includeCiv) {
639                                civilian.addAll(getVariants(spec, true, true, false));
640                        }
641                        
642                        if (data.variants == null || data.variants.isEmpty()) continue;
643                        
644                        other.removeAll(data.variants);
645                        
646                        result.add(data);
647                }
648                
649                other.removeAll(civilian);
650                
651                Collections.sort(result, new Comparator<SimCategoryData>() {
652                        public int compare(SimCategoryData o1, SimCategoryData o2) {
653                                return o1.name.compareTo(o2.name);
654                        }
655                });
656                
657                SimCategoryData custom = getCustomCategory();
658                result.add(0, custom);
659                
660                SimCategoryData def = new SimCategoryData();
661                def.id = DEFAULT_CAT_ID;
662                def.name = "Default";
663                def.nonFactionCategory = true;
664                def.nameColor = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
665                def.iconName = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("simulator", "defaultPlayerCrest");
666                def.data = null;
667                def.faction = createCustomFaction();
668                def.variants = getVariantIDList(sortVariantList(getVariantList(
669                                new LinkedHashSet<String>(Global.getSettings().getSimOpponents()))));
670                result.add(0, def);
671                
672                other.removeAll(def.variants);
673                
674                if (!other.isEmpty()) {
675                        SimCategoryData otherCat = new SimCategoryData();
676                        otherCat.id = OTHER_CAT_ID;
677                        otherCat.name = "Other";
678                        otherCat.nonFactionCategory = true;
679                        otherCat.nameColor = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
680                        otherCat.iconName = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("simulator", "otherPlayerCrest");
681                        otherCat.data = null;
682                        otherCat.faction = createCustomFaction();
683                        otherCat.variants = getVariantIDList(sortVariantList(getVariantList(other)));
684                        otherCat.faction = createCustomFaction();
685                        if (!otherCat.variants.isEmpty()) {
686                                result.add(otherCat);
687                        }
688                }
689                
690                if (!civilian.isEmpty()) {
691                        FactionSpecAPI neutral = Global.getSettings().getFactionSpec(Factions.NEUTRAL);
692                        SimCategoryData civ = new SimCategoryData();
693                        civ.id = CIV_CAT_ID;
694                        civ.name = "Civilian ships";
695                        civ.nonFactionCategory = true;
696                        civ.nameColor = neutral.getBaseUIColor();
697                        civ.iconName = neutral.getCrest();
698                        civ.data = null;
699                        civ.variants = getVariantIDList(sortVariantList(getVariantList(civilian)));
700                        civ.faction = createCustomFaction();
701                        if (!civ.variants.isEmpty()) {
702                                result.add(civ);
703                        }
704                }
705                
706                if (isShowDevCategories()) {
707                        SimCategoryData dev = new SimCategoryData();
708                        dev.id = DEV_CAT_ID;
709                        dev.name = "DevMode stuff";
710                        dev.nonFactionCategory = true;
711                        dev.nameColor = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
712                        dev.iconName = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("simulator", "devModeVariantsIcon");
713                        dev.data = null;
714                        dev.faction = createCustomFaction();
715                        dev.variants = getVariantIDList(sortVariantList(getVariantList(
716                                                        new LinkedHashSet<String>(Global.getSettings().getSimOpponentsDev()))));
717                        result.add(1, dev);
718                }
719                
720                return result;
721        }

723        public List<String> getVariants(FactionSpecAPI spec, boolean withCiv, boolean onlyCiv, boolean forceFullUnlock) {
724                if (spec == null) return new ArrayList<String>();
725                
726                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSettings().createBaseFaction(spec.getId());
727                
728                boolean fullUnlock = isSimFullyUnlocked() || forceFullUnlock || isAllStandardStuffUnlocked();
729                //fullUnlock = true;
730                
731                Set<String> seen = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
732                List<ShipVariantAPI> variantList = new ArrayList<ShipVariantAPI>();
733                for (String roleId : getAllRoles()) {
734                        Set<String> variants = faction.getVariantsForRole(roleId);
735                        if (variants == null) continue;
736                        for (String variantId : variants) {
737                                if (seen.contains(variantId)) continue;
738                                seen.add(variantId);
739//                              if (variantId.equals("onslaught_Standard")) {
740//                                      System.out.println("3f23few");
741//                              }
742                                if (!fullUnlock && !unlocksData.variants.contains(variantId) && 
743                                                !defaultOpponents.contains(variantId)) {
744                                        continue;
745                                }
746                                
747                                ShipVariantAPI v = Global.getSettings().getVariant(variantId);
748                                if (!isAcceptableSimVariant(v, false)) continue;
749                                if (!v.isStockVariant()) continue;
750                                
751//                              if (v == null || !v.isStockVariant()) continue;
752//                              //if (v.isFighter()) continue;
753//                              
754//                              //if (v.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.HIDE_IN_CODEX)) continue;
755//                              if (v.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_SIM) || v.hasTag(Tags.NO_SIM)) continue;
756//                              if (v.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.RESTRICTED)) continue;
757                                
758                                boolean civ = v.isCivilian();
759                                if (civ && !withCiv) continue;
760                                if (!civ && onlyCiv) continue;
761                                
762                                variantList.add(v);
763                        }
764                }
765                
766                sortVariantList(variantList);
767                
768                return getVariantIDList(variantList);
769        }

772        public static List<ShipVariantAPI> getVariantList(Set<String> variants) {
773                List<ShipVariantAPI> variantList = new ArrayList<ShipVariantAPI>();
774                for (String id : variants) {
775                        ShipVariantAPI v = Global.getSettings().getVariant(id);
776                        if (v == null || !v.isStockVariant()) continue;
777                        variantList.add(v);
778                }
779                return variantList;
780        }
781        public static List<String> getVariantIDList(List<ShipVariantAPI> variantList) {
782                List<String> variants = new ArrayList<String>();
783                for (ShipVariantAPI v : variantList) {
784                        variants.add(v.getHullVariantId());
785                }
786                return variants;
787        }
788        
789        public static List<ShipVariantAPI> sortVariantList(List<ShipVariantAPI> variantList) {
790                Collections.sort(variantList, new Comparator<ShipVariantAPI>() {
791                        public int compare(ShipVariantAPI v1, ShipVariantAPI v2) {
792                                if (v1.isCivilian() && !v2.isCivilian()) return 1;
793                                if (v2.isCivilian() && !v1.isCivilian()) return -1;
794                                
795                                if (v1.getHullSize().ordinal() < v2.getHullSize().ordinal()) return 1;
796                                if (v1.getHullSize().ordinal() > v2.getHullSize().ordinal()) return -1;
797                                
798                                int diff = (int) (v1.getHullSpec().getSuppliesToRecover() - v2.getHullSpec().getSuppliesToRecover());
799                                if (diff != 0) return (int) Math.signum(-diff);
800                                
801                                return v1.getHullSpec().getHullName().compareTo(v2.getHullSpec().getHullName());
802                        }
803                });
804                return variantList;
805        }

850        public void applySettingsToFleetMembers(List<FleetMemberAPI> members,
851                                                SimCategoryData category, Map<String, String> settings) {
852        
853                boolean custom = CUSTOM_CAT_ID.equals(category.id);
854                boolean defaultCat = DEFAULT_CAT_ID.equals(category.id);
855                boolean civ = CIV_CAT_ID.equals(category.id);
856                boolean dev = DEV_CAT_ID.equals(category.id);
857                boolean customFaction = custom || civ || dev || defaultCat; 
858                
859                FactionAPI faction = category.faction;
860                
861                String officers = settings.get(OFFICERS_ID);
862                if (officers == null) officers = settings.get(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_ID);
863
864                if (officers != null) {
865                        if (!officers.equals(OFFICERS_NONE) && !officers.equals(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_NONE)) {
866                                CampaignFleetAPI fleetNonAuto = Global.getFactory().createEmptyFleet(faction, true);
867                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
868                                        if (Misc.isAutomated(member)) continue;
869                                        fleetNonAuto.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
870                                }
871                                FleetParamsV3 params = new FleetParamsV3();
872                                boolean all = false;
873                                if (officers.equals(OFFICERS_ALL)) {
874                                        all = true;
875                                        params.officerNumberBonus = 1000;
876                                        params.officerLevelBonus = 10;
877                                } else if (officers.equals(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_5)) {
878                                        all = true;
879                                        params.officerNumberBonus = 1000;
880                                        params.officerLevelBonus = 10;
881                                        params.officerLevelLimit = 5;
882                                } else if (officers.equals(OFFICERS_CUSTOM_6)) {
883                                        all = true;
884                                        params.officerNumberBonus = 1000;
885                                        params.officerLevelBonus = 10;
886                                        params.commander = Global.getFactory().createPerson();
887                                        params.commander.getStats().setSkillLevel(Skills.OFFICER_TRAINING, 1);
888                                        params.officerLevelLimit = 6;
889                                }
890                                FleetFactoryV3.addCommanderAndOfficersV2(fleetNonAuto, params, new Random(), true, all);
891                        }
892                }
893                
894                
895                String cores = settings.get(AI_CORES_ID);
896                boolean derelict = false;
897                if (cores == null) {
898                        cores = settings.get(AI_CORES_DERELICT_ID);
899                        if (cores != null) derelict = true;
900                }
901                if (cores == null) cores = settings.get(AI_CORES_OMEGA_ID);
902                if (cores == null) cores = settings.get(AI_CORES_DEV_ID);
903                
904                if (cores != null) {
905                        if (!cores.equals(AI_CORES_NONE)) {
906                                CampaignFleetAPI fleetAuto = Global.getFactory().createEmptyFleet(faction, true);
907                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
908                                        if (!Misc.isAutomated(member)) continue;
909                                        fleetAuto.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
910                                }
911                                FleetParamsV3 params = new FleetParamsV3();
912                                params.doNotIntegrateAICores = true;
913                                boolean all = false;
914                                boolean omega = false;
915                                if (cores.equals(AI_CORES_SOME)) {
916                                        if (derelict) {
917                                                params.aiCores = OfficerQuality.AI_GAMMA;
918                                        } else {
919                                                params.aiCores = OfficerQuality.AI_MIXED;
920                                        }
921                                } else if (cores.equals(AI_CORES_GAMMA)) {
922                                        params.officerNumberBonus = 1000;
923                                        params.aiCores = OfficerQuality.AI_GAMMA;
924                                        all = true;
925                                } else if (cores.equals(AI_CORES_BETA)) {
926                                        params.officerNumberBonus = 1000;
927                                        params.aiCores = OfficerQuality.AI_BETA;
928                                        all = true;
929                                } else if (cores.equals(AI_CORES_ALPHA)) {
930                                        params.officerNumberBonus = 1000;
931                                        params.aiCores = OfficerQuality.AI_ALPHA;
932                                        all = true;
933                                } else if (cores.equals(AI_CORES_OMEGA)) {
934                                        params.officerNumberBonus = 1000;
935                                        params.aiCores = OfficerQuality.AI_OMEGA;
936                                        all = true;
937                                        omega = true;
938                                }
939                                
940                                // pass in derelictMode = false regardless of derelict or not, since if it's true
941                                // RemnantOfficerGeneratorPlugin does some stuff potentially undesired here
942                                // Setting it to AI_GAMMA above does the job, anyway
943                                RemnantOfficerGeneratorPlugin genPlugin = new RemnantOfficerGeneratorPlugin(false, 1f);
944                                if (settings.containsKey(INTEGRATE_CORES_ID) && settings.get(INTEGRATE_CORES_ID).toLowerCase().equals("true")) {
945                                        if (!omega) {
946                                                genPlugin.setForceIntegrateCores(true);
947                                        }
948                                }
949                                genPlugin.setPutCoresOnCivShips(all);
950                                genPlugin.setForceNoCommander(true);
951                                genPlugin.addCommanderAndOfficers(fleetAuto, params, new Random());
952                                
953                                pruneAICoresToAvailable(members);
954                        }
955                }
956                
957                String personality = null;
958                if (settings.containsKey(AGGRO_ID) || settings.containsKey(AGGRO_ID_CORES_ONLY)) {
959                        String aggro = (String) settings.get(AGGRO_ID);
960                        if (aggro == null) aggro = (String) settings.get(AGGRO_ID_CORES_ONLY);
961                        if (aggro.equals(AGGRO_CAUTIOUS)) {
962                                personality = Personalities.CAUTIOUS;
963                        } else if (aggro.equals(AGGRO_STEADY)) {
964                                personality = Personalities.STEADY;
965                        } else if (aggro.equals(AGGRO_AGGRESSIVE)) {
966                                personality = Personalities.AGGRESSIVE;
967                        } else if (aggro.equals(AGGRO_RECKLESS)) {
968                                personality = Personalities.RECKLESS;
969                        } 
970                }
971                
972                if (personality != null) {
973                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
974                                if (Misc.isAutomated(member)) continue;
975                                
976                                PersonAPI captain = member.getCaptain();
977                                captain.setPersonality(personality);
978                                member.setPersonalityOverride(personality);
979                        }
980                }
981                
982                
983                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getFactory().createEmptyFleet(faction, true);
984                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
985                        fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
986                }
987
988                if (settings.containsKey(RANDOMIZE_VARIANTS_ID) && settings.get(RANDOMIZE_VARIANTS_ID).toLowerCase().equals("true")) {
989                        DefaultFleetInflaterParams params = new DefaultFleetInflaterParams();
990                        params.quality = 2f; // don't add d-mods
991
992                        DefaultFleetInflater inflater = new DefaultFleetInflater(params);
993                        inflater.inflate(fleet);
994                }
995                
996                
997                if (settings.containsKey(QUALITY_ID)) {
998                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
999                                if (member.getVariant().isStockVariant()) {
1000                                        ShipVariantAPI copy = member.getVariant().clone();
1001                                        copy.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
1002                                        member.setVariant(copy, false, false);
1003                                }
1004                        }
1005                        
1006                        String quality = (String) settings.get(QUALITY_ID);
1007                        if (quality.equals(QUALITY_NO_DMODS)) {
1008                                // nothing to do
1009                        } else if (quality.equals(QUALITY_MAX_DMODS)) {
1010                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1011                                        DModManager.addDMods(member, true, 5, null);
1012                                }
1013                        } else if (quality.equals(QUALITY_SOME_DMODS)) {
1014                                Random random = new Random();
1015                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1016                                        int num = 2 + random.nextInt(3);
1017                                        DModManager.addDMods(member, true, num, null);
1018                                }
1019                        } else if (quality.equals(QUALITY_SOME_SDMODS)) {
1020                                Random random = new Random();
1021                                CoreAutofitPlugin plugin = new CoreAutofitPlugin(null);
1022                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1023                                        int num = 1 + random.nextInt(2);
1024                                        plugin.addSMods(member, num, this);
1025                                }
1026                        } else if (quality.equals(QUALITY_MANY_SMODS)) {
1027                                Random random = new Random();
1028                                CoreAutofitPlugin plugin = new CoreAutofitPlugin(null);
1029                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1030                                        int num = 2 + random.nextInt(2);
1031                                        plugin.addSMods(member, num, this);
1032                                }
1033                        }
1034                }
1035                
1036//              for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1037//                      member.setFlagship(false, false);
1038//              }
1039//              fleet.getFleetData().setFlagship(null);
1040                
1041                // not strictly needed anymore after changing FleetFactoryV3.addCommanderAndOfficersV2()

1202        public static void makeFleetCommanderNormalOfficer(List<FleetMemberAPI> members) {
1203                int maxLevel = (int) Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerMaxLevel");
1204                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1205                        PersonAPI captain = member.getCaptain();
1206                        if (!member.isFlagship() && !captain.isDefault()) {
1207                                maxLevel = Math.max(maxLevel, captain.getStats().getLevel());
1208                        }
1209                }
1210                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1211                        if (member.isFlagship()) {
1212                                PersonAPI captain = member.getCaptain();
1213                                member.setFlagship(false, false);
1214                                captain.getStats().setLevel(Math.min(captain.getStats().getLevel(), maxLevel));
1215                                for (String skillId : Global.getSettings().getSkillIds()) {
1216                                        SkillSpecAPI skill = Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(skillId);
1217                                        if (skill.isAdmiralSkill()) {
1218                                                captain.getStats().setSkillLevel(skillId, 0);
1219                                        }
1220                                }
1221                                break;
1222                        }
1223                }
1224        }

1316        public static void pruneFleetDownToDP(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, float targetDP, Random random) {
1317                float currDP = getDP(fleet);
1318                if (currDP > targetDP) {
1319                        fleet.getFleetData().sort();
1320                        
1321                        float fpRem = currDP - targetDP;
1322                        
1323                        while (fpRem > 0) {
1324                                List<FleetMemberAPI> copy = fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
1325                                CountingMap<HullSize> counts = new CountingMap<HullSize>();
1326                                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : copy) {
1327                                        counts.add(curr.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
1328                                }
1329                                WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> picker =  new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>(random);
1330                                for (FleetMemberAPI curr : copy) {
1331                                        float dp = curr.getDeploymentPointsCost();
1332                                        if (dp <= fpRem) {
1333                                                int count = counts.getCount(curr.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
1334                                                float mult = 1f;
1335                                                if (count <= 1) {
1336                                                        mult = 0.0001f;
1337                                                } else {
1338                                                        mult = count;
1339                                                }
1340                                                picker.add(curr, dp * mult);
1341                                        }
1342                                }
1343                                FleetMemberAPI pick = picker.pick();
1344                                if (pick == null) break;
1345                                
1346                                float dp = pick.getDeploymentPointsCost();
1347                                fpRem -= dp;
1348                                fleet.getFleetData().removeFleetMember(pick);
1349                        }
1350                }
1351        }

1353        public static float getDP(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
1354                float total = 0f;
1355                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
1356                        total += member.getDeploymentPointsCost();
1357                }
1358                return total;
1359        }

1424        public boolean isAcceptableSimVariant(ShipVariantAPI v, boolean forLearning) {
1425                boolean allowAll = isSimFullyUnlocked() && !forLearning;
1426                if (v == null) return false;
1427                if ((v.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.NO_SIM) || v.hasTag(Tags.NO_SIM)) && !allowAll) return false;
1428                if (v.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.RESTRICTED) && !allowAll) return false;
1429                if (v.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.STATION)) return false;
1430                return true;
1431        }

1447        public String findBestMatchingFaction(String fleetFactionId, List<FleetMemberAPI> members) {
1448                
1449                List<String> roles = getAllRoles();
1450                
1451                FactionAPI best = null;
1452                float bestScore = 0f;
1453                
1454                for (FactionSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllFactionSpecs()) {
1455                        if (spec == null || spec.getCustom() == null) continue;
1456                        
1457                        JSONObject json = spec.getCustom().optJSONObject("simulatorData");
1458                        if (json == null) continue;
1459                        
1460                        boolean show = json.optBoolean("showInSimulator");
1461                        if (!show) continue;
1462                        
1463                        FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(spec.getId());
1464                        
1465                        Set<String> allVariants = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
1466                        for (String roleId : roles) {
1467                                allVariants.addAll(faction.getVariantsForRole(roleId));
1468                        }
1469                        
1470                        float matches = 0f;
1471                        float total = 0f;
1472                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1473                                String vid = getStockVariantId(member);
1474                                if (vid == null) continue;
1475                                
1476                                if (allVariants.contains(vid)) {
1477                                        matches++;
1478                                }
1479                                total++;
1480                        }
1481                        total = Math.max(total, 1f);
1482                        float score = matches / total;
1483                        if (faction.getId().equals(fleetFactionId)) {
1484                                score *= 1.1f;
1485                        }
1486                        if (score > bestScore) {
1487                                bestScore = score;
1488                                best = faction;
1489                        }
1490                }
1491                
1492                if (best == null || bestScore <= 0) return fleetFactionId;
1493                return best.getId();
1494        }

1496        public void pruneAICoresToAvailable(List<FleetMemberAPI> members) {
1497                if (!isRequireAICoresInCargo()) return;
1498                
1499                CountingMap<String> availableCores = getAvailableMinusDeployedAICores();
1500                
1501                CountingMap<String> current = new CountingMap<String>();
1502                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1503                        String coreId = getCoreId(member);
1504                        if (coreId == null) continue;
1505                        
1506                        current.add(coreId, 1);
1507                }
1508                
1509                CountingMap<String> remove = new CountingMap<String>();
1510                remove.putAll(current);
1511                for (String id : availableCores.keySet()) {
1512                        remove.sub(id, availableCores.getCount(id));
1513                }
1514                
1515                if (remove.isEmpty()) return;
1516        
1517                WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>();
1518                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1519                        String coreId = getCoreId(member);
1520                        if (coreId == null) continue;
1521                        
1522                        if (remove.getCount(coreId) > 0) {
1523                                picker.add(member, member.getDeploymentPointsCost());
1524                        }
1525                }
1526                
1527                while (!remove.isEmpty() && !picker.isEmpty()) {
1528                        FleetMemberAPI member = picker.pickAndRemove();
1529                        
1530                        String coreId = getCoreId(member);
1531                        if (remove.getCount(coreId) > 0) {
1532                                remove.sub(coreId, 1);
1533                                member.setCaptain(Global.getFactory().createPerson());
1534                        }
1535                }
1536        }

1539                if (member == null) return null;
1540                PersonAPI captain = member.getCaptain();
1541                if (captain == null || captain.isDefault() || !captain.isAICore()) return null;;
1542                return captain.getAICoreId();
1543        }

1545        public CountingMap<String> getAvailableMinusDeployedAICores() {
1546                CountingMap<String> cargoCores = getAvailableAICores();
1547                CountingMap<String> deployedCores = getDeployedAICores();
1548                CountingMap<String> availableCores = new CountingMap<String>();
1549                
1550                availableCores.putAll(cargoCores);
1551                for (String id : deployedCores.keySet()) {
1552                        availableCores.sub(id, deployedCores.getCount(id));
1553                }
1554                return availableCores;
1555        }

1560                for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : Global.getCombatEngine().getFleetManager(FleetSide.ENEMY).getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
1561                        if (member.getShip() == null) continue;
1562                        PersonAPI captain = member.getShip().getCaptain();

1595                if (isRequireAICoresInCargo()) {
1596                        if (option.getId().equals(AI_CORES_ID) && extra != null) {
1597                                if (extra.equals(AI_CORES_SOME) ||
1598                                                extra.equals(AI_CORES_GAMMA) ||
1599                                                extra.equals(AI_CORES_BETA) ||
1600                                                extra.equals(AI_CORES_ALPHA)) {
1601                                        CountingMap<String> cores = getAvailableAICores();
1602                                        CargoAPI cargo = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
1603                                        for (String id : cores.keySet()) {
1604                                                cargo.addCommodity(id, cores.getCount(id));
1605                                        }
1606                                        
1607                                        float opad = 10f;
1608                                        info.addSectionHeading("AI cores in cargo & storage", Alignment.MID, initPad);
1609                                        if (cargo.isEmpty()) {
1610                                                info.addPara(BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT + "None", opad);
1611                                        } else {
1612                                                info.showCargo(cargo, 10, true, opad);
1613                                        }
1614                                        
1615                                        cores = getDeployedAICores();
1616                                        cargo = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
1617                                        for (String id : cores.keySet()) {
1618                                                cargo.addCommodity(id, cores.getCount(id));
1619                                        }
1620                                        
1621                                        info.addSectionHeading("Cores already in use in simulation", Alignment.MID, initPad);
1622                                        if (cargo.isEmpty()) {
1623                                                info.addPara(BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT + "None", opad);
1624                                        } else {
1625                                                info.showCargo(cargo, 10, true, opad);
1626                                        }
1627                                        
1628                                        
1629                                        cores = getAvailableMinusDeployedAICores();
1630                                        cargo = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
1631                                        for (String id : cores.keySet()) {
1632                                                cargo.addCommodity(id, cores.getCount(id));
1633                                        }
1634                                        
1635                                        info.addSectionHeading("Cores available to deploy", Alignment.MID, initPad);
1636                                        if (cargo.isEmpty()) {
1637                                                info.addPara(BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT + "None", opad);
1638                                        } else {
1639                                                info.showCargo(cargo, 10, true, opad);
1640                                        }
1641                                }
1642                        }
1643                }
1644        }
